function.name: execute_sql
function.description:
Execute a read-only SQL query against the local DuckDB database.

Schema:
- projects: id (TEXT PK, proj-[uuid]), name (TEXT), description (TEXT), pinned (BOOLEAN), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
- documents: id (TEXT PK, doc-[uuid]), project_id (FK projects.id), name (TEXT), description (TEXT), title (TEXT), time (TIMESTAMP), updated_at (TIMESTAMP), original (TEXT), pinned (BOOLEAN)
- blocks: id (TEXT PK, blk-[uuid]), document_id (FK documents.id), parent_id (FK blocks.id, self-ref for nesting), position (INTEGER), type (TEXT: paragraph|heading|bulletListItem|numberedListItem|checkListItem|image|codeBlock|table), props (JSON), content (JSON)
- annotations: id (TEXT PK, ann-[uuid]), document_id (FK documents.id), text (TEXT), actor (TEXT), color (TEXT: amber|blue|green|etc), reason (TEXT), code_id (TEXT, code-[uuid]), confidence (TEXT: high|medium|low)

Use json_extract or ::json for JSON columns.

sql.description: A valid DuckDB SQL SELECT query. Only read operations are allowed (no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, etc.).
